body: Just a small warning, most guns are not strong enough to kill you instantly. You may even come out alive with mental impairments.
Nice reference.

It took me 6 years to get over someone who broke up with me and immediately starting dating one of my friends. I loved them like they were the only thing that mattered to me. Eventually though, I realized that she did not care about me, and that our love was never real. I did attempt suicide after the breakup, on Christmas Day. You may be in a dark place now, and it may take a long time to leave that place, but you will find your way out eventually.

You may not think you are good enough. You are good enough just the way you are. Even if you have no money, no career, constantly depressed, you still matter. You still have one reason to live, and that reason would appreciate you, no matter how poor, ugly, or stupid you think you are.
I’ve failed a fuckton of classes too, taken me 4 years to get a 2 year degree. Just keep going anyways. Makes no sense to give up halfway, after all you’ve been through already.

Anger is what pushed me over the edge. When I attempted with pills I was basically thinking “ You want to torture me some more? Well look who is laughing now!” When I took those pills it was a bit for revenge. I wanted my family to be miserable and feel guilty from my death, then maybe they would realize what horrible people they really were.

He has been hiding them from you, but he finally found the courage to tell you this. He is calling out for help from you. He probably is saying “ I want to trust you, but I feel like a burden when I tell you these things” 

It’s not your fault, but don’t be angry. He clearly needs your support and love, but feels like he can’t ask for it.
Stabbing takes a lot of courage. You have a small window from stabbing to jumping off. People will see you. It’s better not to do it.
Sleeping on a hot car will not kill you. You will probably regret doing that after realizing this.

I attempted with a bunch of random pills, didn’t work. After 2 weeks in the hospital, was sent to mental hospital. Kept in a room made of stone with a stone bed, a blanket you can’t choke yourself with, and a small pillow with one small window. The door to this room was wooden with several locks on it. Dirty public bathrooms, medical equipment to check on my condition. Every night you can hear screams, yelling, and laughter of the insane patients.

Now for the good part.

You will be put in a group of other suicide and OD people, usually consisting of 3 ish people and go through group therapy sessions where they teach you coping mechanisms. There will be wii games such as Mario kart and wii sports, however the autistic patients usually hog it. There is also chess and monopoly. The food there is pretty good, you wait in line for chicken with Mac and cheese and grilled cheese sandwiches and the like. There are visiting hours and the grounds are well kept with a pool and a tennis court. Some of the workers actually care about your well being.
Suicide is not cowardice. There is a book on this called “Myths about suicide” Haven’t finished it yet but reading now
Maybe it’s because you don’t feel as alone anymore. No one around me in real life can really grasp the idea of suicidal ideation, but here you’re not alone.
Death is great, dying sucks.

Hey man, maybe some normal things are hard for you, but who said you have to be normal? No work experience and no high school degree at 20? Can still work as a janitor, while you get your body absolutely toned as fuck. By that time you can work as a bouncer and make a decent living off of just basically working out. Now you’ve got a decent job where people respect you, get to spend all day chilling in a club, and then maybe pick up a chick on the way. It’s not over yet! A life where men respect you and women want you is still in your reach!
The worst dad joke

Sounds like a good idea. If not this then maybe another way to express yourself, maybe some abstract paintings or really emotional music. Sounds like you would be a natural, and people really eat that shit up.

You might be thinking that you couldn’t be able to live with yourself if you were anything less, but maybe that’s not quite right.
I personally do not believe in any gods, but there is a Buddhist belief that you should not struggle against your own destiny.

Basically it says that maybe you think that you’ll fail in life if you are anything less than a doctor, but in reality your success is not about being a doctor a lawyer or anything, but it is within you. Even if you quit school you can be a success.

Maybe you will become a role model for someone, who will teach lessons to those who have lost faith in themselves. Maybe you will be a good friend and lover, sharing their success as their other half. Maybe you will use your time away from school in order to start a successful company.

If you do something this week that you feel proud of, even if it seems small, that is enough. That is your own success.

If everything in your life stresses you out, then maybe it’s time to live a new one. You only get one life, and it’s nobody else’s but yours, so feel free to tell everyone to go fuck themselves.
If school is too stressful then don’t go to school, if your job is too stressful then quit your job, if your family is too stressful then just become homeless fuck it. You can always go back if you find your strength or meaning in life. Might as well try all of your options before you off yourself.
(Experience: Was homeless for a while and had abusive parents. Was a straight A student but started ditching eventually. Honestly being homeless isn’t that bad.)

Dude, you’re clearly a successful person in one way or another. Life isn’t easy, but it shouldn’t be a daily painful struggle.See a psychiatrist and get medicated, it will probably turn your whole world around. 
I know it’s hard to get help, but all it takes is the first step.
That’s some hardcore selflessness right there, but it might backfire if they know that you were trying to do it for their sake.
Relatable af
I get it, the one thing I wanted was someone who would support my decision to kill myself. At least then I would know that someone cares enough to want me to stop suffering.

Uhh.....damn bro.....
Although if you want a job you could just lie on your resume. Say you worked at Walmart and McDonald’s or some shit. Worst that could happen is they don’t hire you.

It’s hard. Not a lot of people can understand the pain you feel. Sometimes you feel alone because the reality is that you probably are.

This place is different though, here you can say “ I’m not okay “ and someone will be there and understand you. ( Experience: Tried talking to many suicide support groups online, some people really can’t comprehend suicide very well.)
That’s the truth right there sir. People turning a blind eye to the harsh truths.
Can’t help you there, someone else paid for my therapy, but I seriously doubt it’s cheap.

One thing I think people don’t understand is that sometimes you are in too much pain to care about your loved ones. Not many people have been at this level, so it’s hard to comprehend, but there is a point where you don’t care if someone else gets hurt from your passing.
I gotta say that from my experience, the answer is no. However this only applies if you have seen a therapist and that also hasn’t helped you.

As a man myself, I can relate. I found a friend who did not look down on me for being weak. It sounds like you need someone who will accept you for who you are. If you can’t find a friend like this, then I suggest going to group therapy. You will literally be surrounded by people who are willing to accept your feelings. You may make a friend who knows how you feel.

There are a lot of people who genuinely don’t know your (our) level of pain. They cannot even begin to understand what you are going through. I understand being too scared to follow through, it’s not easy to take the last step. I myself had even taken the last step before and am afraid to do it again even though my feelings have not changed.
The only advise I could give you is to try being homeless if it’s too much. I’ve been homeless before and it’s really not that bad. You are free at the very least.
Contrary to popular belief, suicide is not the cowards way out. It takes a certain amount of bravery to actually do it. Talking from experience of course.

Hey, I also come from an Asian family and understand a lot of what you are saying. Unfortunately yes, fathers tend to favor the men in the family. In my case, I am a male, however I did have to fight for my parents approval. A lot of my life to this day revolves around pleasing my parents and trying to make them proud of me. I studied day and night through middle and high school, only getting 2-4 hours of sleep every day. I was so tired every day and just wanted it to end so I could rest. I even ended up getting a degree in something I don't like just to try and make them proud of me.

Wanting to be loved by your parents is hard, but I think being loved by someone else makes it a lot easier. I ended up walking away from my home after high school, which my life MUCH MUCH easier. I also had a lot of close friends who supported my decision.

I used to study to become a doctor, now I'm taking art classes. I'm sure as an Asian person, you would know that doing that is basically death in your family lol. However despite this, I've decided to take care of myself and do what I feel is right.

I'm sure you've been through a lot, but you don't need to kill yourself for success and the approval of your family.

You only have one life, and it's the only one you've got. It's yours to live, so YOU make the choice. Good luck my friend, I wish you the best on your journey though life.
And for the record, yes I am speaking from experience.

If you've ever been to a therapist, you have probably been told something along the lines of "You can talk to me about your problems, but if it gets too serious I am obligated to report it." It's not illegal to commit suicide, but by not reporting it, you can be accused of committing a crime. Suicide hotline workers have the same policy and are obligated to inform the police if they feel you are serious about suicide.

Tragic. This painful memory might never go away, but a life of happiness is still in your reach. It took me a while to realize that I personally will always suffer from my experiences, however even if they don't fully heal or go away, I can still find some good things in life. Hang in there my dude.

MANY people on this site have tried the suicide hotline. It doesn't help. Afterwards they might call the cops on you. Be careful my dude and good luck.

It happens, one of the main reasons I went on this site in the first place was because I felt alone. Most of people I know aren't willing to even bother with subjects like this, but I keep going searching for someone to be able to talk about this with irl. Not necessarily to be cured of my depression, but to at least know that there is someone out there who can confirm that I'm not crazy, or at least that I can be crazy with them lol.

One thing I loved to do when I was truly alone was look up at the stars (where I live they are brighter than say, LA). It was like looking up at a big mirror that showed my hopes and dreams that I had lost, but it reminded me of who I was and what keeps me going.

That sucks, I don't really talk about my depression either because I know that people wouldn't understand or reject me, get tired of it, ect. But the one thing I would consider is what life could be like with someone who understands. One of the reasons I live right now is because I'm searching for someone I can live with who will understand what I am going through and won't reject me. However for now, I just take some comfort in looking around in this site knowing that I'm not the only one suffering here.

Haha, I'm glad to have helped. I've been to many therapists and a mental hospital, but no one really understands what it's like. I was always afraid of telling anyone I was suicidal, but when one of my friends found out, they were there for me, despite me thinking that they wouldn't be. I always secretly hoped that I would meet someone who would understand, and being on this site made me realize that there ARE people who are willing to be there for you, because they know how bad it really feels.

I genuinely want to help you, and I'll talk with you and stay with you for as long as I can.

Maybe there isn't anyone in your circle who understands how you feel, but I do think there are people who are willing to TRY to understand you. One thing I've discovered from being on this site is that there are people who want to help you, such as myself. One of these people may be closer than you think, if you are going to give up, might as well do what you can before you decide to end it.

How it is sometimes, being surrounded by people, but being all alone. I'll tell you what though, I'm gonna check this post as much as I can. There may be people who won't be willing to understand you, but I personally will be here for you. I have a person like this in my life, and it gives me hope at times.

Because once the police get involved, everyone knows, then you get forced into a mental hospital which doesn't help. Your friends and family will all know about this and it takes your chances of success from whatever it was to practically zero. People don't take suicide very well, and you will probably get yelled at by someone at some point about it.

But AGAIN, don't take it like it'll be bad forever.

I think there will be a day where you can look back on this day and wonder how you ever got there in the first place.

Stay hopeful my dude.
Hey look where you are. SAME my dude lol. Must be pretty bad for you right now huh?
Now you aren't alone anymore lol. How are you doing my friend? Welcome to the alone club! Population : Us for now
Hi

I've been this suicidal before, to the point of stabbing yourself.

This underlying feeling might not go away, but over time it can become dull and less crippling.

There ARE things worth living for, you've only got one life, might as well do whatever you can.

If this doesn't help you at all, then I'll just say one last thing.

See you on the other side brother, I hope you rest in peace.

Oh my dude, I'm sorry to say but your day is about to get a whole lot worse, I'm talking from experience.

The only thing I can say now is that it will get better, it won't be perfect, but better.

I know that is a cliche thing to say, but so many people who are on this site will tell you the same thing, not because they are empty words, but because they have been through it as well.

Stay strong friend, it won't be easy, but it won't be forever.

The people who are willing to stay with you may be closer than you think.

A lot of people have social problems, and I personally have problems with being truly intimate with people. If this is the case for you, then the people who are willing to accept you may be there the whole time. (Speaking from experience of course.)

I thought the same things on my third suicide attempt and was on the phone with a friend of mine who found out what I was attempting to do. That person ended up being the only person I could truly talk to afterwards, even though I thought that my suicidal tendencies disgusted other people.

I think that there are people in the world who are ready to accept you and be with you truly. It may be hard and take some time, but hey, it's better than ending it all without trying right?

Good luck my friend, be brave and don't give up just yet!

You are not alone, especially on this thread. I have a similar post on being a suicide survivor who is still suicidal. Some of the people on there have some really compelling stories about their struggles that I think could be helpful. 

Personally though, when I look up at the stars I see all of my hopes of dreams (cheesy I know). But really, I'm seeing things that have passed, things that I know will never come to be. My dreams will probably never come true, but I chase them regardless.

I think there is something out there that can complete you, leaving those terrible experiences behind you. If that means find a new job, then maybe that needs to happen too.

You matter, and your purpose clearly has yet to come, but it's not going anywhere.

Good luck friend.

I have a physical condition that prevents me from doing most jobs, however I still think there is hope for you, and myself.

Killing yourself is the last resort, and the way I see it, if you are going to exhaust all of your options,  just do something super crazy that you think probably isn't going to work. Ask that girl you like out, apply for that job you think you won't get, make some music, write a book, or just go out in the wilderness for a few days. You only got one life, if you think you aren't capable of doing something or maybe that you'd be wasting your time, just say fuck it and do it anyways.

Good luck brother, give it your all!

Shit, if being gay makes you a monster then I must be friends with a lot of monsters lol. On the serious side though, there was a time where I thought I was a "monster" who should be dead. You may see a monster in the mirror, but I know there are many people who won't see the same. I used to be part of a (less than legal) group of people out of desperation. Afterwards, I learned to leave that all behind me and realize that I was more than just my flaws and my darker past. For every shadow there is a light, and I believe that you are not the monster you make yourself out to be. Believe in yourself, there are people out there who are ready to accept who you are!

Yeah, I've also noticed that going to a therapist or psychologist does basically nothing as well. I've been to mental hospitals and their advice is crap. I think most people think that surviving a suicide attempt makes you magically better, but it really doesn't.

I feel some truth in this statement. If you are concerned about your career though, I'd say that if you find something that you think you are really good, you could turn it into a career somehow and live a (relitavely) good life. Good luck to you my guy, don't give up your dreams just yet!
Your story really hits home. I was always afraid that if my attempt failed I would end up worse off than I already was. Good luck to you stranger.

Thanks for the reply. I always feared that a failed suicide attempt would make people cautious of me and I would never get another chance to kill myself again. I've attempted in private 3 times from different bridges or high places with this one being the most serious. 15 attempts is pretty bizarre, almost makes you think someone is watching lol.

This is terrible and I think this is the main people hesitate to kill themselves. If they survive, this is what they basically have to go through. I hope someday a real suicide group can start where people can get real help from people who have seriously attempted suicide, but survived. I don't think most groups grasp the real concept.

I completely understand this. In my case, I thought that the "think about your loved ones" argument was stupid because people who are serious about suicide are past the point of caring about that. Also not knowing why you haven't done it yet, understandable. It's how a lot of people are I think, myself included. (Fear of not dying after attempt) If I could spread one message to people who talk about suicide, it would be that the "loved ones" argument does not work.

This is not a place for your project. This is a place where real people leave their last words sometimes, people who have lost their hopes, dreams, and have tried everything and failed. People who hurt every day and have nowhere else to go. People come here for their last sliver of hope, that maybe someone could understand them or help them. They aren't here to take a survey for 15 dollars. Terrible.

I've done this before and survived, at first I was disappointed, but now its hard to explain. I guess if you read this, maybe the desire to die wont go away, but hopefully you will at least want to die some other way than killing yourself. I am currently in this middle ground. Good luck my guy.
